title: Marathon Petroleum Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Marathon Petroleum Corporation and subsidiary MPLX LP entered into new revolving credit agreements on April 7, 2026, replacing their respective 2022 credit facilities. MPC's new facility is $5.0 billion over five years; MPLX's is $2.5 billion over five years. No borrowings were outstanding under the prior agreements. MPC had $2.2 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of March 31, 2026; MPLX held $1.5 billion of that amount.
key_points: MPC entered into a new $5.0 billion, five-year unsecured revolving credit facility maturing April 7, 2031
MPLX LP entered into a new $2.5 billion, five-year unsecured revolving credit facility maturing April 7, 2031
Both new agreements replaced prior 2022 credit agreements; no borrowings outstanding under the prior agreements
MPC had $2.2 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of March 31, 2026; MPLX held $1.5 billion of that amount
The MPC credit agreement includes a leverage covenant capping Consolidated Net Debt to Total Capitalization at 65%
Borrowings under both facilities accrue interest at Term SOFR plus applicable margin, with commitment fees ranging from 10-25 bps
